Implement dependency_layers(graph). graph maps string node names to iterables of prerequisite node names. Return a list of topological layers: each layer contains all currently runnable nodes sorted lexicographically; a node is runnable only after all its dependencies appeared in EARLIER layers. Deduplicate repeated dependencies. Include isolated nodes. Raise ValueError for any dependency not present as a key, self-dependency, or any cycle (including in a disconnected component). Empty graph returns []. Do not mutate the graph or its dependency lists. Dependency values may be one-shot generators.
